changelog:
- Initial release of the kirk-summarize skill.
- Summarize URLs, local files (PDFs, images, audio), and YouTube links via the summarize CLI.
- Unified API key (SKILLBOSS_API_KEY) supports all major LLM providers through SkillBoss API Hub.
- Includes powerful flags for summary length, format, extraction fallback, and YouTube handling.
- Optional config file support and advanced web/YouTube scraping fallback integrated.
summary: Summarize URLs, local files (PDFs, images, audio), and YouTube links using the summarize CLI with customizable length and model options.
